title: Round-trip identity — basic atomic heading (h2, html-v3 title, _cssid tolerated)
_comment: WP-Q05 (14-fixtures-harness.md §7). build(input_tree) → get_structure → normalize(both) → assert structural equality. `normalized_expected` is exactly normalize(input_tree): empty `styles`/`editor_settings`/`interactions`/`elements` sibling keys dropped; the auto-injected `_cssid` (has-atomic-base.php:310-321) is stripped on read so it does not show as a spurious diff (RESEARCH §4.1). Ids are NOT compared literally — the round-trip test re-IDs structurally (C2/R5: element ids AND local-style ids are re-minted on save). Run as ADMIN so the content-sanitizer title rewrite is exempt (RESEARCH §2.1/§6.6, §7 step 3). prefilter.verdict:defer because the html-v3 title prop is non-trivial (PHP dry_run is authoritative).
